summary: Bradford County steel Blaw-Knox tower, built 1922 and removed 1946 per the FFLOS register; no source found describing the site today.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1946 according to the FFLOS register.

events.note: Register says built in 1922 as a steel Blaw-Knox tower, also known as Kahill and Cahill.
Register says the tower was removed in 1946.
Registered September 16, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg.

evidence.supports: site is in Bradford County, Pennsylvania
steel Blaw-Knox tower, also known as Kahill and Cahill, built 1922, removed 1946
evidence.quote: This steel Blaw-Knox tower, also known as Kahill and Cahill, was built in 1922 and removed in 1946.

evidence.supports: Blaw-Knox towers erected 1922 and 1923 (general remark in the post, not about Kahill)
post is about a different tower, Little Flat
evidence.quote: I can reduce it to Little Flat, based on topography and other clues.

sources.title: Kahill Tower Site

notes_for_editor: The register is the only Kahill-specific source; its 1922 build and 1946 removal are unconfirmed elsewhere. Source 2 (June 2021 post) dates Blaw-Knox towers in general to 1922-23, but the post is about Little Flat, so it is context only and is not evidence for Kahill. Elevation disagrees: register gives 2,302 ft (702 m); TopoQuest gazetteer gives 2296 ft MSL for the same coordinates. Not used in the story; not cited. Coordinates N 41.591742, W -76.601338 match the brief, and the brief's elevation_m (701.6) matches the register's feet value. Two web searches found no other Bradford County source and nothing describing the site today; the site's public status is unknown.
